english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for having doubts or lacking conviction about something.
Use 疑問 when emphasizing an unresolved doubt or a question someone still has, rather than a general issue.
Use this when the doubt is an unresolved question or uncertainty about an issue.

examples.english: I still have uncertainty about this decision.
examples.traditional: 我對呢個決定仲有疑問。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 zung6 jau5 ji4 man6

examples.english: This answer still leaves me with a question.
examples.traditional: 呢個答案令我仲有疑問。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 daap3 on3 ling6 ngo5 zung6 jau5 ji4 man6

examples.english: I still have a doubt about this matter.
examples.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 zung6 jau5 ji4 man6
